risk_description:
Defective hydraulic unit of the braking system may cause a limited braking support and increased braking distance. Moreover, in such cases the ABS system would not be available. 
This will lead to increased risk of an accident.
model_types: Types: G234M, 7L, G8C, G3XE, F8CM, G5X, G6X, F56XM, G7X
